findings.title: All-skipped suite returns rc=0 from run_weekly but is never recorded as a pass
findings.detail: pytest exits 0 for a fully skipped suite, so run_weekly returns rc=0 while status=blocked; the truth is carried by ledger ok=False, the weekly_alert.jsonl blocked entry, and the release gate going red. Verified by probe b: _suite_outcome('5 skipped') -> (False, 'blocked'), alert entry status=blocked, gate ready=False. Design-intentional (CA-203 RED reversal) and safe.

findings.title: Freshness boundary is strictly > 7d = stale; exactly 7d = fresh
findings.detail: ZR-902 freshness_status uses age > max_age_hours, so exactly 7d (168h) is fresh and 7d+1h is stale — matches C2 '<=7d' semantics. Old green (ok=True, 8d) is stale; not-ok at any age is stale; absent ledger is missing. All four states verified independently.
